schemaNote: BookBookKit's bundled price list (architecture.md §7.10). Per-token prices checked against https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard tier) on 2026-11-08. Image-model output-token counts are measured for gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (SP-2, SP-6); the other image models reuse that table until measured.

estimation.notes: Output tokens are not proportional to pixel count (low 1024x1536 < low 1024x1024), so only interpolate within one quality and aspect class; prefer measured entries. Input-image tokens are measured at three sizes. They fit "downscale to <= 512 px a side, then 1 token per 16x16 patch" (hypothesis; Phase 9 measures a 1536x1024 reference).
